purpose: Independent supplemental controls for the standalone requested-resume-grid fix on current Main.
prerequisites: Both current native binaries already exist; this protocol performs no build, install, download or foreign process control.
NumPy and Pillow are importable in the selected Python runtime.
Verify every entry of portable-data/manifest.json before use; hash the actual volume, resume, parameters, manifest and both binaries before and after.
timeout_action: Kill and reap only the Popen child created by this script; retain exit code, PID, argv, hashes, stdout, stderr and timeout marker.

disabled-positive-extra.input: fixtures/development, a fully valid 5x5 crop; prediction data from portable-data/prediction-roi.zarr
disabled-positive-extra.coordinate_rule: Output TIFF index minus metadata grid_offset [column,row] gives an index in the input resume grid.
fixed_gates: All original 25 grid locations remain valid.
Every valid point has row in [0,5) and column in [0,6).
At least one actual new point is in column 5; no requirement of all five new points before execution.
Every valid point has nonzero generation; new points have generation later than the input maximum.
disabled-positive-extra.baseline_gate: At least one valid point outside that requested region reproduces the baseline overrun; all actual baseline violations are retained.
disabled-positive-extra.xyz_policy: Original XYZ are not required to remain fixed during positive growth; the existing solver may adjust them.

fresh-seed.seed_origin: Exact Float32 XYZ at the center of fixtures/development; checked before running.
gates: Both outputs contain at least the four initialized valid vertices with generations in [1,4).
Metadata confirms explicit_seed mode, the requested seed, a valid positive two-axis scale, and absence of resume grid_offset.
Baseline and fixed x.tif, y.tif, z.tif and generations.tif have identical raw file SHA256 values.
The corresponding decoded arrays have identical dtype, shape and complete bytes, including invalid cells.
fresh-seed.optional_observation: Record whether valid points exceed four; if not, claim only initialization/equality control, not positive fresh growth.
fresh-seed.metadata_scope: Do not require whole meta.json equality: UUID, elapsed time, paths and incidental fields are not equality targets.

adjudication.exit_0: All declared gates met after four completed native processes and unchanged inputs/binaries.
adjudication.exit_1: A declared completed-output gate was unmet; inspect exact per-profile findings before assigning a cause.
adjudication.exit_2: Input, native execution, timeout or decoding error; no completed regression result is implied.

limits: One public PHerc0139 fixture and one prediction carrier, not four independent datasets.
No measurement of physical sheet assignment, ink, readability, accuracy or generalization.
No GUI, neural, inpaint, growth_scale>0, Linux/macOS or full application acceptance claim.
Paired wide-control comparison belongs to the separate main-suite analysis and is not performed by this script.
